description: Corrected run: establish that Moh1 is 138 residues with no C-terminal extension past the Yippee domain, unlike Mis18 whose DNA-binding extreme C terminus lies in a 64-residue tail; retrieve IntAct interaction records for P38191; compare N- and C-terminal extension lengths across 500 fungal PF03226 proteins
code:
import requests, re, json, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import Counter

UA = {'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'}
POS, NEG = set('KR'), set('DE')
def charge(s): return sum(c in POS for c in s) - sum(c in NEG for c in s)
def pct(s, grp): return 100*sum(c in grp for c in s)/len(s) if s else float('nan')

def fasta(ac):
    t = requests.get(f'https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{ac}.fasta', headers=UA, timeout=60).text
    return ''.join(t.split('\n')[1:]).strip()

MOH1, MIS18, YPEL5, CRBN = fasta('P38191'), fasta('Q9P802'), fasta('P62699'), fasta('Q96SW2')
print('lengths: Moh1/P38191 %d | spMis18/Q9P802 %d | hYPEL5/P62699 %d | hCRBN/Q96SW2 %d'
      % (len(MOH1), len(MIS18), len(YPEL5), len(CRBN)))

# cross-check the length against SGD, since I had previously assumed 211 aa
print('\n==== Length cross-check ====')
try:
    s = requests.get('https://www.yeastgenome.org/backend/locus/YBL049W', headers=UA, timeout=60)
    print('  SGD HTTP', s.status_code)
    if s.status_code == 200:
        j = s.json()
        print('  SGD display_name:', j.get('display_name'))
        print('  SGD description:', (j.get('description') or '')[:260])
        for k in ('protein_length', 'length', 'protein_overview'):
            if k in j: print('  SGD', k, ':', j[k])
except Exception as e:
    print('  SGD query failed:', type(e).__name__, e)
try:
    j = requests.get('https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P38191.json', headers=UA, timeout=60).json()
    print('  UniProt sequence length:', j['sequence']['length'])
    feats = [(f['type'], f['location']['start']['value'], f['location']['end']['value'],
              f.get('description', '')) for f in j.get('features', [])]
    print('  UniProt features:')
    for t, a, b, d in feats[:18]:
        print('    %-16s %3d-%-3d %s' % (t, a, b, d[:60]))
except Exception as e:
    print('  UniProt json failed:', type(e).__name__, e)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 1. architecture
print('\n==== Domain architecture: where is each protein mass? ====')
ARCH = [('Moh1 P38191',  MOH1,  41, 138),
        ('spMis18 Q9P802', MIS18, 1, 130),
        ('hYPEL5 P62699',  YPEL5, 1, 119),
        ('hCRBN Q96SW2',   CRBN, 318, 425)]
for nm, s, lo, hi in ARCH:
    nt, dom, ct = s[:lo-1], s[lo-1:hi], s[hi:]
    print('  %-16s total %3d | N-ext %3d (net %+d) | Yippee %3d (net %+d) | C-ext %3d (net %+d)' % (
        nm, len(s), len(nt), charge(nt), len(dom), charge(dom), len(ct), charge(ct)))
print('\n  spMis18 extreme C-terminal 30 aa : %s  net %+d, K+R %.0f%%'
      % (MIS18[-30:], charge(MIS18[-30:]), pct(MIS18[-30:], POS)))
print('  Moh1 last 30 aa (inside the domain): %s  net %+d, K+R %.0f%%'
      % (MOH1[-30:], charge(MOH1[-30:]), pct(MOH1[-30:], POS)))
print('\n==== Moh1 regions ====')
for nm, s in [('N-term 1-40', MOH1[:40]), ('Yippee 41-138', MOH1[40:])]:
    print('  %-14s n=%3d net %+3d  K+R %4.1f%%  D+E %4.1f%%  S+T %4.1f%%  P %4.1f%%  aromatic %4.1f%%'
          % (nm, len(s), charge(s), pct(s, POS), pct(s, NEG), pct(s, 'ST'), pct(s, 'P'), pct(s, 'FWY')))
print('  full length    n=%3d net %+3d' % (len(MOH1), charge(MOH1)))
print('  Moh1 N-term sequence 1-40: %s' % MOH1[:40])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 2. pLDDT
af = requests.get('https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/P38191', headers=UA, timeout=60).json()[0]
pdb = requests.get(af['pdbUrl'], headers=UA, timeout=60).text
pl = {int(l[22:26]): float(l[60:66]) for l in pdb.splitlines()
      if l.startswith('ATOM') and l[12:16].strip() == 'CA'}
plddt = np.array([pl[i] for i in sorted(pl)])
print('\n==== AlphaFold pLDDT ====  model residues: %d' % len(plddt))
for nm, lo, hi in [('N-term 1-40', 1, 40), ('Yippee 41-138', 41, 138)]:
    v = plddt[lo-1:hi]
    print('  %-14s mean %5.1f  median %5.1f  frac<50 %4.1f%%  frac>70 %4.1f%%'
          % (nm, v.mean(), np.median(v), 100*(v < 50).mean(), 100*(v > 70).mean()))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 3. IntAct
print('\n==== IntAct (PSICQUIC) records for P38191 ====')
rows = []
try:
    url = ('https://www.ebi.ac.uk/Tools/webservices/psicquic/intact/webservices/current/'
           'search/query/id:P38191?format=tab25')
    r = requests.get(url, headers=UA, timeout=120)
    print('  HTTP', r.status_code, '| bytes', len(r.text))
    if r.status_code == 200 and r.text.strip():
        for ln in r.text.strip().split('\n'):
            f = ln.split('\t')
            if len(f) < 12: continue
            a, b = f[0], f[1]
            partner = (b if 'P38191' in a else a).split(':')[-1]
            names = re.findall(r':([A-Za-z0-9_\-]+)\(gene name\)', f[4] + '|' + f[5])
            gene = [g for g in names if g.upper() != 'MOH1']
            meth = re.findall(r'\((.*?)\)', f[6])
            pub = re.findall(r'pubmed:(\d+)', f[8])
            typ = re.findall(r'\((.*?)\)', f[11])
            rows.append({'partner': partner, 'gene': gene[0] if gene else '',
                         'method': meth[0] if meth else '', 'type': typ[0] if typ else '',
                         'pmid': pub[0] if pub else ''})
except Exception as e:
    print('  IntAct query failed:', type(e).__name__, e)

if rows:
    print('  %d records' % len(rows))
    print('\n  detection methods:')
    for m, c in Counter(x['method'] for x in rows).most_common():
        print('    %-52s %3d' % (m, c))
    print('\n  interaction types:')
    for m, c in Counter(x['type'] for x in rows).most_common():
        print('    %-52s %3d' % (m, c))
    print('\n  source publications:')
    for p, c in Counter(x['pmid'] for x in rows).most_common():
        print('    PMID %-10s %3d records' % (p, c))
    part = {}
    for x in rows:
        part.setdefault(x['gene'] or x['partner'], set()).add(x['method'])
    print('\n  %d distinct partners:' % len(part))
    for k in sorted(part):
        print('    %-16s %s' % (k, '; '.join(sorted(part[k]))[:80]))
    HT = ('affinity chromatography', 'tandem affinity', 'two hybrid array',
          'proteomics', 'genetic interference', 'imaging')
    binary = [x for x in rows if 'two hybrid' in x['method']]
    print('\n  records by two-hybrid: %d' % len(binary))
else:
    print('  no records parsed from IntAct')

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 4. extensions in homologs
print('\n==== N- and C-terminal extensions across fungal PF03226 proteins ====')
q = ('https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream?format=fasta&query='
     '%28xref%3Apfam-PF03226%29+AND+%28taxonomy_id%3A4751%29')
txt = requests.get(q, headers=UA, timeout=240).text
seqs = {}
for blk in txt.split('>')[1:]:
    ln = blk.split('\n')
    ac = ln[0].split('|')[1] if '|' in ln[0] else ln[0].split()[0]
    seqs[ac] = ''.join(ln[1:]).strip()
print('  retrieved %d fungal PF03226 sequences' % len(seqs))

pat = re.compile(r'C..C')
def zinc_span(s):
    st = [m.start() for m in pat.finditer(s)]
    for i in st:
        for j in st:
            if 40 <= j - i <= 90:
                return i, j
    return None

nex, cex, keep = [], [], []
for ac, s in seqs.items():
    z = zinc_span(s)
    if z is None or len(s) < 80: continue
    nex.append(z[0]); cex.append(len(s) - (z[1] + 4)); keep.append(ac)
nex, cex = np.array(nex), np.array(cex)
zm = zinc_span(MOH1)
moh1_n, moh1_c = zm[0], len(MOH1) - (zm[1] + 4)
print('  Moh1 zinc motif indices %s (C45 -> 44, C101 -> 100 expected)' % (zm,))
print('  Moh1 N-ext %d aa, C-ext %d aa' % (moh1_n, moh1_c))
print('  homologs n=%d' % len(nex))
print('  N-ext  median %.0f  IQR %.0f-%.0f  mean %.1f' % (
    np.median(nex), np.percentile(nex, 25), np.percentile(nex, 75), nex.mean()))
print('  C-ext  median %.0f  IQR %.0f-%.0f  mean %.1f' % (
    np.median(cex), np.percentile(cex, 25), np.percentile(cex, 75), cex.mean()))
print('  Moh1 N-ext percentile %.1f ; C-ext percentile %.1f' % (
    100*(nex < moh1_n).mean(), 100*(cex < moh1_c).mean()))
print('  homologs with C-ext >= 40 aa (Mis18-like tail): %.3f (n=%d)' % (
    (cex >= 40).mean(), (cex >= 40).sum()))
print('  homologs with N-ext >= 30 aa (Moh1-like extension): %.3f (n=%d)' % (
    (nex >= 30).mean(), (nex >= 30).sum()))
mis_z = zinc_span(MIS18)
if mis_z:
    print('  spMis18 N-ext %d aa, C-ext %d aa' % (mis_z[0], len(MIS18)-(mis_z[1]+4)))
yp_z = zinc_span(YPEL5)
if yp_z:
    print('  hYPEL5  N-ext %d aa, C-ext %d aa' % (yp_z[0], len(YPEL5)-(yp_z[1]+4)))

bigc = [a for a, c in zip(keep, cex) if c >= 40]
if bigc:
    cc = [charge(seqs[a][zinc_span(seqs[a])[1]+4:]) for a in bigc]
    print('  among homologs with C-ext >= 40: mean net charge %+.2f, fraction net-positive %.2f'
          % (np.mean(cc), np.mean([x > 0 for x in cc])))
bign = [a for a, n in zip(keep, nex) if n >= 30]
if bign:
    nc = [charge(seqs[a][:zinc_span(seqs[a])[0]]) for a in bign]
    print('  among homologs with N-ext >= 30: mean net charge %+.2f, fraction net-positive %.2f'
          % (np.mean(nc), np.mean([x > 0 for x in nc])))
    print('  Moh1 N-ext net charge %+d' % charge(MOH1[:moh1_n]))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- figure
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(15.5, 4.4))

ax[0].plot(np.arange(1, len(plddt)+1), plddt, color='#2c3e50', lw=1.3)
ax[0].axhspan(0, 50, color='#e74c3c', alpha=0.10)
ax[0].axhspan(70, 100, color='#27ae60', alpha=0.10)
ax[0].axvspan(41, 138, color='#3498db', alpha=0.18)
ax[0].text(90, 15, 'Yippee domain 41-138', ha='center', fontsize=8.5)
ax[0].text(20, 15, 'N-term\n1-40', ha='center', fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_xlabel('Moh1 residue'); ax[0].set_ylabel('AlphaFold pLDDT'); ax[0].set_ylim(0, 100)
ax[0].set_title('Moh1 is 138 aa: a disordered N-terminal 40\nand the domain, with nothing after it', fontsize=10)

y = np.arange(len(ARCH))
for k, (nm, s, lo, hi) in enumerate(ARCH):
    ax[1].barh(k, lo-1, color='#e67e22', edgecolor='w')
    ax[1].barh(k, hi-lo+1, left=lo-1, color='#3498db', edgecolor='w')
    ax[1].barh(k, len(s)-hi, left=hi, color='#c0392b', edgecolor='w')
ax[1].set_yticks(y); ax[1].set_yticklabels([a[0].split()[0] for a in ARCH], fontsize=9)
ax[1].set_xlabel('residue')
ax[1].set_title('Orange N-extension, blue Yippee domain,\nred C-extension', fontsize=10)
ax[1].annotate('Mis18 DNA-binding\nextreme C terminus', xy=(190, 1), xytext=(210, 1.9),
               fontsize=7.5, arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', lw=0.9))

ax[2].scatter(nex, cex, s=10, c='#95a5a6', alpha=0.6, label='fungal PF03226 (n=%d)' % len(nex))
ax[2].scatter([moh1_n], [moh1_c], s=90, c='#c0392b', zorder=5, label='Moh1')
if mis_z: ax[2].scatter([mis_z[0]], [len(MIS18)-(mis_z[1]+4)], s=90, c='#27ae60', zorder=5, label='spMis18')
if yp_z: ax[2].scatter([yp_z[0]], [len(YPEL5)-(yp_z[1]+4)], s=90, c='#2980b9', zorder=5, label='hYPEL5')
ax[2].set_xlim(-3, 120); ax[2].set_ylim(-3, 150)
ax[2].set_xlabel('N-terminal extension (aa)'); ax[2].set_ylabel('C-terminal extension (aa)')
ax[2].legend(fontsize=7.5); ax[2].set_title('Moh1 has an N-extension and no C-tail', fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
